scope: 44 players and 8 captains; Ranked Solo/Duo only
method: Maximum by tier, division and LP among current rank, current Top tier, all available historical high_rank_info and historical rank_info in the public OP.GG profile HTML. Three independent batch cross-checks agreed.
limitations: OP.GG lacks within-season peaks for many older seasons. Season-end records establish a known rank, not proof that no higher unrecorded peak existed. No Flex or ranked-team records included. This is a dated snapshot, not automatic synchronization.
